selection: H824 document hash order from existing H681 source pool, exclude all2560 prior BSF documents including reserved test. No new corpus documents. Novel to this early BSF panel, not all research/model pretraining.
donors: Only H822 count-eligible token/block clouds. Same token and absolute sampled position, different document, both block active. For each receiver require >=4 eligible donors; nearest and farthest decoded contribution. Require far distance>=1.5*near and near>1e-8.
receiver_selection: First4 receivers per block by deterministic hash among qualifying candidates. No downstream logits or outcomes read.
future_interventions: Near/far block directions rescaled to common near distance; controls use training PCA16 and fixed random16 projection of each full donor residual difference rescaled to same norm. Full native-scale donor swaps separate descriptive arm. Near/far is not causal evidence of smooth manifold without downstream comparison.
status: capture and freeze pair identities, no outcome evaluation
